decision.formal_text: Proposal-only screening BANNED; route candidates straight to the 44b6-first held-fit graph gate.

exclusions.reason: Proposal metrics exist, but exact graph scoring was not entered.
Precision/utility/support exist, but no exact graph output was produced.
Proposal utility/precision exist; the report explicitly says no predictions were emitted and no graph replay occurred.
ROC AUC 0.918491 (gain +0.077265) is banked, but the row is ranking-only with no graph or prediction CSV.
Proposal precision/support exist, but the support gate failed before score.
Graph deltas exist, but no comparable proposal precision/utility-gain/AUC/support proxy is banked for the scored identity.

Adjusted/raw graph deltas are measured, but the nine added proposals are an observation-difference count, not labeled proposal support, precision, utility gain, or AUC; treating nine as support would mix definitions.

inventory_rescan.note: Other proposal-report examples lack a measured graph outcome; other graph outcomes lack a comparable proposal precision, utility gain, AUC, or support value for the scored identity.

limitations: Only four mechanism/identity clusters have comparable precision/support and graph evidence.
Utility gain has only one independent candidate and AUC has none with a graph delta, so neither can be correlation-tested.
The primary bootstrap is very small-sample and tie-heavy; its intervals are descriptive error bars, not asymptotic guarantees.
The complete-row inventory contains eight graph outcomes but only four mechanism/identity clusters; naïve complete-row ranks overweight APNCC and temporal repeats.
The temporal fold sensitivity can expose within-mechanism behavior but cannot establish cross-candidate proxy validity.
Raw scorer edge Jaccard is explicit for CTRL-OOF-GRAPH and exactly derivable from banked scorer TP/FP/FN for the other three primary candidates.
